summary: Iteration 42 — Cantine Module Phase A: comprehensive backend testing (23/23 pytest passing) + frontend smoke tests of public + staff cantine pages. Fixed a React useEffect bug in StaffCantinePointage.jsx (`destroy is not a function`) that was rendering the runtime error overlay and blocking the tablet pointage UI.

ui_bugs.issue: useEffect(focus, []) where focus() returned setTimeout's numeric ID, causing React 'destroy is not a function' runtime error overlay. The overlay blocked all interactions with /staff/cantine/pointage. FIXED by wrapping: useEffect(() => { focus(); }, []).

action_items: Verify the StaffCantinePointage fix (already applied) is acceptable — alternative is to convert focus to use a proper cleanup pattern (already used at line 83-87 of same file). No other code-level changes required for Phase A.
Optional: consider seeding settings.current_period proactively at app startup so the auto-renew job behaves deterministically across deployments (it is currently lazy-created).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/cantine.py is 733 lines — still single-file but acceptable for Phase A. Consider splitting into public/staff/scheduler modules in Phase B.
Reservations cap is 2000 rows in /staff/cantine/reservations and 5000 rows in exports — fine for current scale; add pagination if user-base grows.
GOOD: _job_monthly_renew is idempotent (period stamp prevents double-renew); _ensure_unique_code retries up to 20 times.
GOOD: All Mongo lookups use {_id: 0} projection to avoid ObjectId leakage.
GOOD: All public POST endpoints validate input via Pydantic (Field min/max length, Literal types).
MINOR: export_pdf signature does not include 'all' in Literal scope (xlsx does); minor inconsistency, no functional impact.

rca of the issue.bug: React runtime overlay 'destroy is not a function' on /staff/cantine/pointage
rca of the issue.root_cause: useEffect(focus, []) — focus() returned setTimeout's integer ID. React interprets a non-function return value as an invalid cleanup function and throws on unmount.
rca of the issue.reproduction: Login as admin → navigate to /staff/cantine then /staff/cantine/pointage → red error overlay covers page; data-testid selectors inaccessible.
rca of the issue.mitigation: Wrapped the focus() call in an arrow function so the effect returns undefined: `useEffect(() => { focus(); }, []);`. Verified: page now loads cleanly, no JS errors, all data-testid selectors present.
